description: National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) Data and Insights is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by National Disability Insurance Agency (NDIA). The National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) provides data on the number of participants, providers and market utilisation for different regional areas. Data is available in interactive graphs, dashboards and can be downloaded. Data is available for NDIA Service Districts, LGAs and SA2s. Data on participants includes age, primary disability, level of function, Indigenous status and remoteness. Coverage is Australia, 2021 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: Report (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
